column1: Further full-time study among undergraduates from all provider types by demographic group, 2024
Data for all columns is filtered to: ANALYSIS = 1, Undergraduate: LEVEL = 1, e942 = 0

* Socio-economic status data for 2022 and 2023 has been updated in 2024 to reflect revised information in the 2022 Higher Education student statistics collection (HESSC). Note that student completion data from 2021 and 2022 form the population data for GOS 2022 and 2023 respectively.
† Locality statistics are calculated according to proportion for both metro and regional/remote categories.
† Location data are only reported for Commonwealth assisted students, which excludes international and domestic full fee paying students.
